create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass to configure MLIP inference with tf32, activation checkpointing, and precision options
build_inference_settings_default: build a python module that calls inference_settings_default to get default MLIP inference configuration settings
run_inference_settings_turbo: run inference_settings_turbo to get optimized MLIP inference settings with tf32, merged MOLE experts, and compilation enabled
test_inference_settings_traineval: test inference_settings_traineval to get training and evaluation mode MLIP inference settings with graph generation version 1
review_guess_inference_settings: review guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name or InferenceSettings object into the correct inference configuration
